UIbasic — Basic Persistent User Interface Protocol — v1.0 QUICKSTART

1.  Open or attach the application/project to update.
2.  Run UIbasic_v1.0_MASTER.txt.
3.  Default to UI AUTO.
4.  Allow UIbasic to inventory and integrate with the existing
    architecture.
5.  Run applicable QA.
6.  Package the complete updated project only AFTER the update is
    implemented and verified.

Manual display commands: UI TINY UI COMPACT UI FULL UI AUTO
